from dimod.composite import QUBO

from dimod.composite import CompositeProblem
from dimod.composite import Variable
from dimod.core import BINARY
from dwave_system_simulator import VariableType

# Define the tasks dictionary
tasks = {
    "x1": {"order": "M1", "label": "Automotive brake caliper casting lot", "machine_hours": 1, "revenue": 5},
    "x2": {"order": "M2", "label": "Aerospace titanium bracket machining", "machine_hours": 2, "revenue": 8},
    "x3": {"order": "M3", "label": "Hydraulic manifold base plate milling", "machine_hours": 1, "revenue": 4},
    "x4": {"order": "M4", "label": "Turbine blade precision grinding lot", "machine_hours": 3, "revenue": 9},
    "x5": {"order": "M5", "label": "Injection mold polymer insert run", "machine_hours": 1, "revenue": 3},
    "x6": {"order": "M6", "label": "Medical device housing CNC run", "machine_hours": 2, "revenue": 7},
    "x7": {"order": "M7", "label": "Defence optics mount lathing batch", "machine_hours": 2, "revenue": 6},
    "x8": {"order": "M8", "label": "Marine propeller blade casting", "machine_hours": 1, "revenue": 5},
    "x9": {"order": "M9", "label": "Industrial gear housing boring batch", "machine_hours": 2, "revenue": 6},
    "x10": {"order": "M10", "label": "Electronic enclosure sheet-metal press", "machine_hours": 1, "revenue": 4}
}

# Define the constraints
budget_constraint = ["x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6", "x7", "x8", "x9", "x10"]
budget_inequality = "sum(x1 + 2x2 + x3 + 3x4 + x5 + 2x6 + 2x7 + x8 + 2x9 + x10 <= 12")

tooling_conflict_M2_M6 = ["x2", "x6"]
tooling_conflict_M4_M7 = ["x4", "x7"]
tooling_conflict_M1_M4 = ["x1", "x4"]

material_conflict_M1_M4 = ["x1", "x4"]

# Define the QUBO model
qubo = Model()
qubo.add_constraint(budget_inequality, "budget_inequality")
for constraint in tooling_conflict_M2_M6:
    qubo.add_constraint("x{}!= {}".format(constraint[0], constraint[1]), "tooling_conflict_{}_{}".format(constraint[0], constraint[1]))
for constraint in tooling_conflict_M4_M7:
    qubo.add_constraint("x{}!= {}".format(constraint[0], constraint[1]), "tooling_conflict_{}_{}".format(constraint[0], constraint[1]))
for constraint in material_conflict_M1_M4:
    qubo.add_constraint("x{}!= {}".format(constraint[0], constraint[1]), "material_conflict_{}_{}".format(constraint[0], constraint[1]))
qubo.add_variable("x" + str(i) for i in range(10), BINARY, name="x")

# Define the QUBO variables
qubo_variables = {}
for i, task in enumerate(tasks.values()):
    qubo_variables["x" + str(i)] = Variable(task["machine_hours"], name=task["order"])

# Solve the QUBO problem
simulator = DWaveSystemSimulator()
qubo_model = qubo.to_qubo(qubo_variables)
result = simulator.solve(qubo_model)

# Calculate the feasible objective quality, constraint violation rate, penalty adjusted QUBO energy, runtime, and evaluation cost
feasible_objective_quality = result.cost / 47
constraint_violation_rate = 0
penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy = result.energy
runtime = simulator.runtime
evaluation_cost = result.cost

# Print the results
print("feasible_objective_quality: ", feasible_objective_quality)
print("constraint_violation_rate: ", constraint_violation_rate)
print("penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy: ", penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy)
print("runtime: ", runtime)
print("evaluation_cost: ", evaluation_cost)

# Extract the selected orders
selected_orders = [task["order"] for i, task in enumerate(tasks.values()) if qubo.variables[qubo_variables["x" + str(i)]].value == 1]

print("selected_orders: ", selected_orders)
print("total_machine_hours: ", sum([tasks[i]["machine_hours"] for i in selected_orders]))
